notes: Full description: LintResult (pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:201) and Severity (line 121) are public enums with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Any downstream crate that pattern-matches exhaustively on these enums will break when a new variant is added (e.g., a future 'Timeout' or 'Skipped' LintResult variant, or a new Severity tier). Since pkix-lint is explicitly designed to be extended, these enums will grow. MSRV is 1.73 so #[non_exhaustive] is available. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to LintResult, Severity, Scope, and SubjectKind. Note: SubjectKind is used in internal matching (SubjectKind::matches) with a match arm on 'other' that catches everything, so adding non_exhaustive there is safe internally. The risk is to external code that pattern-matches these enums.
title: RUSTY: LintResult not #[non_exhaustive]
